premise: a city builder of furnaces, steam engines and a research tree, in a frozen industrial age

slots.name: foundry/panel
slots.note: A large industrial-age interface panel, completely opaque and solid everywhere including its centre: its whole face one even plate of blackened cast iron (#231f19), the same tone from its edge to its centre with a faint fine grain: no inner rectangle, no darker or lighter centre, no inset, no vignette. It is framed by a 4 px polished brass rim (#b8893f, lit #e0b86a along its top edge, shadowed #6e4f22 along its bottom) with small round brass rivets in its four corners and a fine dark line just inside the rim. Corners cut by a small 45° chamfer of about 6 px. No gears, no pipes, no text. As the settings and research frames of the concept. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: foundry/card
slots.note: A building or research card, repeated many times side by side: dark iron (#211f1d) with a 2 px brass rim (#a77c3a) and one small rivet in each corner, a small 45° chamfer at the corners. Plain inside, no glow, no text. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: foundry/field
slots.note: A plain dropdown or input box: a recessed black iron well (#141312) with a 1.5 px dull brass edge (#8a6a36) and a faint inner shadow along its top. Square corners. No rivets, nothing else. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: foundry/slot
slots.note: A slot repeated many times in a grid: a sunken square of dark iron (#191817) with a 2 px brass rim (#9a7536) darkened at its top, a 1 px dark inner line. Square corners; plain; no rivets, no glow. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: foundry/tooltip
slots.note: A small tooltip: a fully opaque dark iron plate (#1a1817) with a 1.5 px brass edge (#a77c3a) and a tiny rivet in each corner. Square corners; plain inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: foundry/hud
slots.note: A HUD readout plate laid over a city scene: a small opaque rectangle of dark iron (#1d1b1a) with a 2 px brass rim (#a77c3a, lit along its top) and one small rivet in each corner, its centre plain. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: foundry/button
slots.note: A secondary button or tab: a raised plate of dark iron (#2c2926) with a 2 px brass rim (#a77c3a, lit #d8ad62 along its top, darker along its bottom) and a small 45° chamfer at its corners; the label area plain so cream text reads on it. Hovered: the rim brighter. No rivets in the middle, no icons, no text. As the inactive tabs of the concept. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: foundry/button-primary
slots.note: The primary button: a plate of glowing furnace orange (#f0843a) filling the whole piece, a brighter hot core at its centre (#f6a060) and a 2 px brass rim (#b8893f), a soft warm glow just inside the rim, a small 45° chamfer at its corners. Its label area even orange so near-black text reads on it. No gear, no text. As the BEGIN RESEARCH button of the concept. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: foundry/corner
slots.note: A small corner mark: a riveted brass corner bracket, an L of polished brass (#c4954a) about 20 px each way and 4 px thick with two round rivet heads, on a clear background. As the brass corners of the concept's frames. Nothing else.

slots.name: foundry/divider
slots.note: A horizontal divider: one thin polished brass rule (#b8893f) 2 px tall with a 1 px dark line under it, even from end to end, on a clear background. As the rule under MUSIC in the concept.

slots.name: foundry/flourish
slots.note: A heading accent: a small brass cog wheel about 18 px across with six teeth and a dark hub, on a clear background. Nothing else.

slots.name: foundry/thumb
slots.note: A slider's thumb: one narrow upright polished brass lever block (#c4954a, lit along its left, shadowed along its right) centred in a square image, as tall as the image and about a third as wide (8 of 24), with rounded ends. Fully transparent to its left and right. As the brass handles on the concept's sliders. Nothing else: no track.

slots.name: foundry/knob
slots.note: Only the sliding knob of a toggle switch, not the switch: one small round polished brass knob (#d8a85a) with a lit top and a dark rim, as the lever head of the concept's ON toggle. Fully transparent around it.

slots.name: foundry/knob-off
slots.note: Only the sliding knob of a toggle switch, not the switch: one small round dull dark bronze knob (#6c5a40) with a dark rim, as the lever head of the concept's OFF toggle. Fully transparent around it.
